Q9029.reason: Hypotonic water absorbed across the bladder mucosa can disturb sodium and other electrolytes, so saline is used for washout.

Q9030.reason: The son’s rights had not vested because he learned of the promise only after the parties modified it and payment was made.

Q9031.reason: A general anti-assignment clause is read to bar delegation of duties, not assignment of the right to payment, unless that right is specifically restricted.
